metadata.title: Load & Validate QA Config
metadata.purposeAndUsage: Load and validate the .ai/qa-config.json team configuration file. If the file is missing or contains null values, auto-discover settings from the work item area path. Ensures all required QA configuration fields are resolved and confirmed by the user before proceeding.

output.description: Fully resolved qa-config with team settings, plan ID, suite IDs, and base branch

prerequisites: Work item ID available in process parameters
Access to Azure DevOps MCP tools
specificActions: Follow the substeps below in sequence
Config file path: .ai/qa-config.json in the repository root
Required fields: ado_project, test_plan_id, services_suite_id, releases_suite_id, area_path, team_name, base_branch
If config file exists: parse all fields and check for null values
If config file is missing or has null values: run auto-discovery from work item area path

Auto-discovery: extract team name from area path, list test plans and match by team name, list suites to find Services/Releases root IDs, detect base_branch by checking origin/master, origin/main, origin/develop in order
If auto-discovery fails to find a matching test plan: ask user for the test plan ID directly
Do NOT proceed until config is fully resolved and confirmed by user
tools: mcp__azuredevops__testplan - List test plans to match by team name
mcp__azuredevops__testplan_test_suite_write - List suites to find Services/Releases root IDs
git - Detect base branch (origin/master, origin/main, origin/develop)
bestPractices: Always validate all 7 fields before proceeding
Prefer existing config values over auto-discovered ones
Present all resolved values to user in a clear summary before confirming
Log whether config was loaded from file or auto-discovered
If any auto-discovery step fails, ask user rather than guessing

substeps.name: Check for qa-config.json
substeps.description: Check if .ai/qa-config.json exists in the repository root
actions: Look for .ai/qa-config.json in the repo root directory
Note whether file exists or is missing

substeps.name: Parse existing config or prepare for auto-discovery
substeps.description: If config exists, parse and extract all fields. Check for null values.
actions: If config file exists: read and parse JSON
Extract fields: ado_project, test_plan_id, services_suite_id, releases_suite_id, area_path, team_name, base_branch
Check each field for null or missing values
If all fields are populated: skip to substep 3 (present for confirmation)
If any fields are null/missing: proceed to substep 2 for auto-discovery of those fields

substeps.name: Auto-discover missing values from work item area path
substeps.description: For any null or missing fields, auto-discover from work item area path and ADO APIs
actions: Extract team name from work item area path (e.g., 'Payoneer\Team\SubTeam' -> extract team identifier)
List test plans in ADO and match by team name to find test_plan_id
If no matching test plan found: ask user for the test plan ID directly
List suites under matched test plan to find Services and Releases root suite IDs
Detect base_branch by checking existence of branches in order: origin/master, origin/main, origin/develop
Set ado_project to 'Payoneer' if not already set
Set area_path from work item if not already set

substeps.name: Present values for user confirmation
substeps.description: Display all resolved config values and ask user to confirm
actions: Present a clear summary of all 7 config fields with their resolved values
Indicate which values came from file vs auto-discovery
Ask user to confirm all values are correct
If user requests changes: update the specific fields
Do NOT proceed until user explicitly confirms

substeps.name: Store resolved config in memory
substeps.description: Save the confirmed configuration to process memory
actions: Write all 7 config fields to memory under qaConfig object
Include metadata: source (file/auto-discovered/user-provided) for each field
Log the config resolution outcome

substeps.name: End-Step: Compliance Check
substeps.description: Verify principles were followed in this step
actions: Verify: Was log.json updated for any user interactions?
Verify: All 7 config fields are non-null and confirmed by user
Verify: Were mandatory actions confirmed with output?
Output: 'Step completed in compliance with operating principles'

flow.description: Check config file existence -> Parse if exists (check for nulls) -> Auto-discover missing values from area path and ADO APIs -> Present all values for user confirmation -> Store resolved config in memory. Auto-discovery (substep 2) is conditional, only runs if config is missing or has null fields.

memoryFileUsage.readFrom: Process parameters for workItemId, work item details for area path
memoryFileUsage.writeTo: qaConfig object with all 7 resolved fields
fields: Information Produced: qaConfig.ado_project, qaConfig.test_plan_id, qaConfig.services_suite_id, qaConfig.releases_suite_id, qaConfig.area_path, qaConfig.team_name, qaConfig.base_branch
Decisions Made: Config source (file vs auto-discovered vs user-provided)
Notes: Any auto-discovery failures, user overrides
